item.title: Goodbye Microslop: Finally Moved to Codeberg
item.description: A while ago I realized I was after something important to my soul. I had internal conflicts because even though I was kind of living according to my values in terms of being thoughtful about the software I use, I don’t want to use products of evil corporations such as Microslop – that goes against the things I want to nurture in myself, thus in others, and consequently in this industry, as a professional (when I become one) and in all humanity.
